mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t.product_name ASC ) AS no, t.product_name AS product_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(TRIM(t.code_number)), ''), '-') AS product_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(TRIM(t.specification)), ''), '-') AS specification, COALESCE(MAX(m.minimum_quantity), 0) AS minimum_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN t.in_quantity > 0 THEN t.in_quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.out_quantity > 0 THEN t.out_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS current_stock FROM ${table} t LEFT JOIN stock_minimum_settings m ON m.product_name = t.product_name WHERE t.product_name IS NOT NULL AND t.product_name != '' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.product_name HAVING current_stock != 0 ORDER BY t.product_name ASC

SELECT product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN in_quantity > 0 THEN in_quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN out_quantity > 0 THEN out_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_stock FROM ${table} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
AND (target_system IS NULL OR target_system != 'SOT')
GROUP BY product_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_minimum_settings (product_name, minimum_quantity) VALUES (#{productName}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE minimum_quantity = VALUES(minimum_quantity), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
